specs.title: / renders the TodoMVC app
/active renders the TodoMVC app
/completed renders the TodoMVC app
unknown route shows 404 page
adds a todo when Enter is pressed
input is cleared after adding a todo
pressing Enter with blank/whitespace input does not add a todo
pressing Enter with empty input does not add a todo
new-todo input is auto-focused on page load
can add multiple todos
new todo is prepended to the list (newest first)
clicking checkbox marks todo as completed
clicking checkbox again unmarks completed todo
delete button removes a todo
deleting the only todo hides the footer
double-clicking a todo label enters edit mode
editing a todo and pressing Enter saves the new text
editing a todo and pressing Escape exits edit mode when text is valid
editing a todo and blurring saves the new text
editing to empty text and blurring deletes the item
toggle-all checkbox completes all todos
toggle-all unchecked uncompletes all todos
clear completed removes all completed todos and keeps active ones
clear completed button not shown when no completed todos
clear completed removes only completed items, preserving active count
counter shows 1 item left for one active todo
counter reflects uncompleted count with mixed todos
All filter shows all todos
Active filter shows only uncompleted todos
Completed filter shows only completed todos
Active filter hides completed todos
Completed filter hides active todos
selected filter link has "selected" class
direct navigation to /active shows correct items
direct navigation to /completed shows correct items
counter always shows uncompleted count regardless of filter
footer is not visible when there are no todos
todo list is not rendered when there are no todos
footer and list appear when first todo is added
footer and list disappear when last todo is deleted
todos persist after page reload
completed state persists after reload
edited todo text persists after reload
